model.name: v11 c150 FP8
model.training: v11: 300 steps, lora_rank=64, freeze_vit=false, acceleration-profile trajectory features in prompts

verdict.structural_finding: Acceleration features expand classification behavior (saves) but DO NOT break the new-venue goal-recall ceiling (1/16). Per v8 memory, the bottleneck is visual feature extraction at frame_width=1280 — ball too small to perceive at distant cameras. Trajectory features cannot fix what the ViT cannot see.
verdict.production_recommendation: Keep v10 c150 as production model. v11 not a clear win on agg F1 + lost goal precision on game_22.

recommended_next_steps.name: Score-change detector via scoreboard OCR
recommended_next_steps.rationale: Direct attack on the goal-detection problem at the data-source level. If scoreboard regions can be reliably OCR'd, score delta + ~30s context window gives a perfect-recall goal detector regardless of camera quality. This sidesteps the ViT bottleneck entirely.
recommended_next_steps.effort: ~1 week: scoreboard region detector + OCR pipeline + integration

recommended_next_steps.name: Ball-centric crop pipeline
recommended_next_steps.rationale: Use v9b trajectory to crop a 512x512 region around the ball, feeding the model a zoomed view alongside the wide view. Addresses the 'ball too small' problem at the ViT input layer.
recommended_next_steps.effort: ~1 week: crop pipeline + new training data + LoRA retrain

recommended_next_steps.name: Higher input resolution (frame_width=1920)
recommended_next_steps.rationale: Simplest fix for ball perception — bigger input pixels means more ViT tokens covering the ball. Cost: ~2x inference wall time per game. May not be worth it for marginal F1 lift.
recommended_next_steps.effort: ~2 days: pipeline reconfig + retrain at 1920px + eval

recommended_next_steps.name: Tame v11's save FPs and ship it
recommended_next_steps.rationale: v11 found 2 new saves on new venues. With a tighter prompt asking for acceleration-only-when-conf-high, the save detection signal might be salvageable as an additive feature alongside v10 c150.
